# Throughput scaling, take 2: full datasets (no epoch restarts within 60 steps), persistent MIOpen
# cache, samples/s from the step 41-60 log window. Runs alone on the node.
scale2-act-1g|act-base|0|1|--batch_size=32 --steps=60 --log_freq=20 --save_freq=100000 --num_workers=8 --dataset.episodes=null|export MIOPEN_USER_DB_PATH=/outputs/rocm-train/miopen/fast/db;;export MIOPEN_CUSTOM_CACHE_DIR=/outputs/rocm-train/miopen/fast/cache;;mkdir -p $MIOPEN_USER_DB_PATH $MIOPEN_CUSTOM_CACHE_DIR
